name: Honey
oneLiner: Honey is Berachain's native fully-collateralized dollar token, minted 1:1 against approved stable assets where some routes carry mint/redeem fees.
collateral: 1:1 basket of USDC.e, USDt0, BYUSD, and USDe on Berachain
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint/redeem against centralized stablecoin collateral with Basket Mode safety

applicabilityBasis.summary: Honey is a Berachain-native asset with stablecoin-like use and reserve-backed mechanics, but current public materials do not establish an issuer obligation that clearly resolves GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability.

genius.notes: GENIUS applicability remains unclear because Honey is protocol-native and reserve-backed, but the public source set does not clearly establish an issuer-redeemable payment stablecoin obligation.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin and public releases (bulletin-2026-3, FR 2026-04089)
Federal Register search for Berachain or HONEY PPSI filings
Berachain Foundation corporate profile (Cayman Islands, George Town)
Web search for Berachain GENIUS Act compliance filings 2026
OCC digital asset licensing applications tracker
NCUA PPSI application and standards proposals
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or announced intent was located for HONEY or the Berachain Foundation. The issuer is a Cayman Islands foundation with no publicly disclosed U.S. regulatory pathway under the GENIUS Act.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: HONEY resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: HONEY is minted through the Berachain HoneyFactory by depositing whitelisted stablecoin collateral (USDC, USDT0, pyUSD/BYUSD, USDe) into per-asset vaults; collateral whitelisting and mint/redeem rates are configured by a 3/5 Berachain multisig holding DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE on the HoneyFactory, with Basket Mode safety controls.

controls.label: HoneyFactory mint hub
controls.capDescription: HONEY mints only when whitelisted stablecoin collateral is deposited through the HoneyFactory into per-asset vaults; Basket Mode restricts mint/redeem when a collateral asset depegs.
controls.evidence: At Berachain block 22086398, paused() returned false; ABI-verified source (Routescan) confirms HoneyFactory is an ERC1967 UUPS proxy implementing AccessControl with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MANAGER_ROLE, and PAUSER_ROLE; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xd13948f99525fB271809F45c268d72A3C00a568d) returned true; hasRole(MANAGER_ROLE keccak256, same address) returned true.

controls.label: Berachain HoneyFactory admin (3/5 Safe)
controls.evidence: At Berachain block 22086398, getOwners() on 0xd13948f99525fB271809F45c268d72A3C00a568d returned 5 addresses; getThreshold() returned 3; getModules() returned empty array; guard slot returned zero; masterCopy() returned 0x3e5c63644e683549055b9be8653de26e0b4cd36e (Gnosis Safe L2 v1.3.0); fallbackHandler slot = 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, this address) on HoneyFactory = true.

review.evidence: At Berachain block 22086398: HoneyFactory (0xA4aFef880F5cE1f63c9fb48F661E27F8B4216401) is an ERC1967 UUPS proxy (impl 0x6331f0a4e0220a14be27bd31af091f0a1ac036a1, verified source HoneyFactory.sol on Routescan) implementing AccessControl; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE=bytes32(0), 0xd13948...) = true; hasRole(MANAGER_ROLE keccak256, same) = true. The admin is a 3/5 Gnosis Safe (getOwners 5 signers, getThreshold 3, no modules, no guard, masterCopy = Safe L2 v1.3.0 at 0x3e5c63...). HONEY token slot0 = HoneyFactory address confirming factory-only minting.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: HONEY is minted and redeemed against an approved dollar-stablecoin reserve basket, with no borrower CDP position.
